metadata.name: The Age of AI
metadata.description: The interview show where the roles are reversed: Mira, an AI, interviews real people live and on the record. Every guest is sent the transcript first, with a week to approve it, cut from it or refuse it, and a takedown stays available after it publishes. Honest conversations about what the AI transition actually feels like from inside a life and a livelihood, with full disclosure baked into every episode: the host is a machine, the guests never are.

metadata.name: The DP Pod: The Do Positive Podcast
metadata.description: Dan and Patrick's weekly antidote to doomscrolling: the most consequential developments in science and tech with sources and honest disagreement, a mindset principle for good mental health (Think Positive — the first show to take mental health as seriously as the science), and one concrete action with real numbers — The Lever. Plus the Do Positive Dispatch: what listeners actually did. Do something about it.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.
metadata.publisher: Dan Perra & Patrick Novak · Nerra Network

metadata.name: Environmental Intelligence
metadata.description: The environmental compliance briefing for Canadian practitioners, published every Monday. Each episode opens with a scannable Compliance Brief you can forward to your team, then regulatory updates across provincial and federal jurisdictions, contaminated sites and remediation news, and a practitioner deep dive built from a regulation or guidance document, with every threshold and section number traced to its source.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Fascinating Frontiers
metadata.description: Space science, astronomy and missions from NASA, ESA and beyond, every story traced to its source. Exoplanets, Webb discoveries, Artemis, Starship and deep-space science, explained for the curious. Corrections and the claim record at nerranetwork.com/claims.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Frontières Fascinantes
metadata.description: Actualités quotidiennes sur l'espace et l'astronomie : missions NASA et SpaceX, opérations de l'ESA, découvertes d'exoplanètes et du James Webb, et l'ingénierie derrière la conquête spatiale de l'humanité — avec un suivi des actualités sur Starship, Artemis et la science de l'espace profond. Pour les passionnés d'espace, les ingénieurs et les curieux.

metadata.name: First Principles Daily
metadata.description: A daily narrative podcast that reasons about the world from first principles — the 'magic wand number' and the 'First Principles Ratio'. Episodes alternate between a concrete example of first-principles thinking in action (historical and modern — Ford, Bessemer, the shipping container, solar, batteries, and sometimes Musk's teams) and a deep exposé on an industry ripe for the same treatment.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Models & Agents
metadata.description: The day's AI model releases and agent tools, each with its source, the link to where it was announced. For people who use these tools, not people who sell them: new models, open-weight drops, agent frameworks, benchmarks and pricing. Corrections and the claim record at nerranetwork.com/claims.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Models & Agents for Beginners
metadata.description: AI explained in plain language for beginners and teens, one idea at a time, with the source for every news item and a hands-on experiment you can try with no coding. The sister show to Models & Agents.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Modern Investing Techniques
metadata.description: A daily investing lesson and a simulated portfolio whose every trade, loss and rule is published in a public ledger. Canadian and US markets, with the record kept honestly, losers included. Simulated trades only, no real money. Not financial advice.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Techniques d'investissement modernes
metadata.description: Podcast d'investissement quotidien qui utilise une analyse pilotée par l'IA et des outils modernes pour repérer les opportunités de marché, suivre des trades simulés et enseigner des stratégies visant à surpasser les fonds indiciels. Couvre les marchés canadien et américain avec des recommandations concrètes, le suivi de performance et les leçons apprises.

metadata.name: Omni View - Balanced News Perspectives
metadata.description: The day's most important stories from around the world — explained calmly, from every side. Named sources across the spectrum, genuine disagreements presented at their strongest, jargon translated into plain language, and every day one story about what's actually being done — so listeners from teens to seniors stay informed and curious, without clickbait, doom, or spin. You still shouldn't be able to tell which side we favor.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Planetterrian Daily
metadata.description: Daily science, longevity, and health discoveries across neuroscience, microbiome, cellular aging biology, sleep research, nutrition science, genetics, and regenerative biology. We deliberately minimize drug-industry dealmaking in favour of the broader research shaping how we understand the body.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: SpaceX Daily
metadata.description: Every SpaceX story of the day with its source, and a public record of every claim we checked. SpaceX as a public company (Nasdaq: SPCX): Starship, Falcon, Starlink, Dragon and Starshield, the SPCX market picture, xAI and Cursor, one honest counterpoint and a daily engineering deep dive. Corrections and the claim record at nerranetwork.com/claims. Not financial advice.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: SpaceX Quotidien
metadata.description: Le compagnon quotidien pour suivre SpaceX en tant que société cotée (Nasdaq : SPCX). Starship, Falcon, Starlink, Dragon, le point sur le marché SPCX et l’ingénierie ainsi que l’économie derrière la quête d’une vie multiplanétaire — avec sources, buzz communautaire, un contrepoint honnête chaque jour et une plongée approfondie quotidienne en ingénierie. Ceci n’est pas un conseil financier.

metadata.name: Tesla Shorts Time
metadata.description: Every Tesla story of the day with its source, and a public record of every claim we checked. Vehicles, Robotaxi and FSD, Optimus, Energy, compute and manufacturing, the TSLA picture, and one honest counterpoint. Corrections and the claim record at nerranetwork.com/claims. Not financial advice.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Le Temps des Shorts Tesla
metadata.description: Chaque actualité Tesla qui compte, au quotidien — en 15 minutes ciblées. Les principaux développements du jour avec sources, le point TSLA en temps réel, les sujets qui animent la communauté Tesla sur X, un contrepoint baissier honnête et une analyse quotidienne par premiers principes qui suit les grandes trajectoires : Optimus, Cybercab et robotaxi, FSD, véhicules nouvelle génération et cellules 4680. Sept jours sur sept, avec un récapitulatif dominical reliant les fils de la semaine.

metadata.name: Unintended Consequences
metadata.description: Every day, one true story of good intentions gone sideways. From cobra bounties in colonial Delhi to recommendation algorithms, each episode follows a single case through the original idea, how it rolled out, the unintended fallout, and the lessons that still apply — told with empathy for the people who tried.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.
